basicInfo.aboutMe: I'm a recent B.Tech graduate in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (CGPA 9.21/10) with hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle - from SQL data modelling and ETL pipelines, to machine learning model development and deployment, to the business intelligence dashboards decision-makers actually use. I enjoy working across the stack: cleaning and modelling raw data, building and deploying ML systems, and automating workflows end to end. I'm currently looking for opportunities as a Data Analyst, Machine Learning Engineer, or Data Engineer.

projects.title: CreditGuard - Credit Risk Scoring & Monitoring Platform
description: Predicts 12-month probability of default across 50,000 applicant records, returning a 300-900 credit score with an Approve / Review / Reject decision and SHAP reason codes.

Covers the full ML lifecycle - data validation, feature engineering, MLflow-tracked training, FastAPI scoring, PSI drift monitoring, and automated retraining - across five Docker services with GitHub Actions CI.

projects.title: Enterprise Sales Analytics Dashboard
description: Modelled a star-schema data warehouse of 4 fact and 7 dimension tables over 250,000 orders, 20,000 customers, and 1,000 products.
Delivered three interactive dashboards - executive KPIs, sales performance, and customer/product analytics - with custom DAX measures and drill-down filtering.

projects.title: Real-Time Voice AI Agent
description: Streams speech-to-text, LLM inference, and text-to-speech over persistent WebSockets, engineered to a sub-2-second end-to-end response target.
Benchmarked per-stage latency to isolate the bottleneck, then overlapped TTS synthesis with token generation via sentence-level streaming.

projects.title: SignMindX - Real-Time Gesture Recognition System
description: Classifies 21-point 3D hand landmarks into OS-level actions in real time on CPU-only hardware, with no GPU required.
Reduced false positives using EMA smoothing and majority-vote temporal filtering, on a multi-threaded capture / inference / execution architecture.
